Sample.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/13] Eligible patients were randomly assigned to fluoxetine alone, CBT alone, fluoxetine with CBT, or placebo using a computerized stratified randomization, a 1:1:1:1 treatment allocation ratio, permuted blocking (first block size=4, with subsequent random block sizes of 4 and 8) within each stratum, and site and sex as stratification variables.
